scalars.scalar_value: Experience working in a college or higher education facilities department, including custodial, maintenance, or related operations.

items.item_text: Experience working in a college or higher education facilities department, including custodial, maintenance, or related operations.
Experience supervising and leading staff in a unionized workforce, including assigning, scheduling, inspecting, and prioritizing work and coordinating with contractors.
Experience with custodial methods, equipment, cleaning chemicals, safety practices, facility operations, and applicable regulations, including Title 5 requirements.

Experience using work order/ticketing systems and standard computer software, with the ability to maintain accurate records, manage resources, and communicate effectively with employees, students, contractors, and campus stakeholders.
Experience applying policies and procedures, and responding effectively to routine and emergency situations;
Experience with inventory management, budgeting, and/or general understanding of payroll policies.
